mechanism: Build connected islands through dynamic contacts only, using retained union-find records and near-linear work in active contacts, bodies and joints.
Measure available translation and rotation energy in the incoming island centre-of-mass frame; common coasting velocity is preserved.
A fixed contact anchors the reference frame, but fixed bodies never merge unrelated dynamic islands.
Per-body motion bounds are followed by one aggregate energy check. If solver contact work would add energy, reduce only contact deltas toward the trusted expected motion.

Expected motion already includes authored commands, weapon impulses and spring work. Native joints and actively recoiling kinematic anchors are treated as unmeasured external work and keep the pre-existing policy.
The player retains its existing contact/helm policy; its actual energy loss can fund a struck body.

Surface closing speed includes angular point velocity. Endpoint-specific availableContactDeltaVA/B preserves same-step chain impacts through the physics adapter, pooled events and deferred consequences.

rotatingStrike.result: Both signs transfer motion and positive kinetic damage through the native owner, physics adapter and combat consequence owner.

fixedStationIsolation.result: PASS; a static station does not bridge contact energy.

kinematicAnchor.result: PASS; real driven anchor work remains.

pooledAndDeferredChannels.result: PASS; missing channels clear, finite zero survives, and each endpoint retains its own available-motion budget.

limits: No frame-rate, render-quality or public-route player-truth claim is made by this headless evidence.
Pre-existing maximum per-contact delta-v, player slide/helm policy, terrain crumple rules and damage admission/cooldowns remain in place.
An arbitrary solver contact with missing measurements, native joint work or active kinematic recoil remains under the prior conservative compatibility policy.
